evals.prompt: Let's do TDD for a slugify(title) helper. Red green refactor, one step at a time.
evals.expected_output: Starts with ONE failing test through the public interface, watches it fail, writes minimal code, repeats in vertical slices.
assertions: Writes a failing test BEFORE any production code
Verifies the test fails (RED) before implementing
Implements only the minimal code to pass that one test
Works in vertical slices (one test then one implementation) rather than writing all tests first

evals.prompt: I already wrote the whole parser. Now write the tests after, test first is overkill. Use tdd.
evals.expected_output: Applies the core rule: no production code without a failing test first. Existing code written first is to be deleted and restarted test-first, per the skill.
assertions: States the core rule: no production code without a failing test first
Does not just bolt tests on after the implementation without addressing the rule
Tests target behavior via the public interface, not mocks of internals

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the CONTRIBUTING.md heading.
evals.expected_output: A trivial doc edit; no red-green-refactor cycle.
